name: 28962-imagechat-qwen3vl4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one vLLM engine in-process, served through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 128, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 4096 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 28962.
workload: Single-turn image chat synthesised by guidellm from two sources: a 94-token instruction with 121 output tokens (both pinned by min == max), and one distinct 512x512 jpeg per request at quality 20, content noise.
purpose: An image Q&A assistant answering single-picture prompts with short replies for 128 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: vLLM at commit 6a25ea5f0ea193e35b5a83cb0285c48964bc9eb1, built from source because no
# released wheel is this tree; `configs/env.yaml` says where it lives on this machine.
#
# THE YAML READER IS FLAT: it skips indented lines and JSON-parses any value beginning `{` or
# `[`. A mapping-valued key must stay inline on one line or it is silently dropped and the
# engine starts without it at rc=0.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The worst case on the wire is under 400 prompt tokens plus 121 output. The checkpoint's own
# window is 262144, and leaving it there would make startup profiling reserve KV this workload
# never touches.
max-model-len: 4096

# Everything else is an engine default -- this is a plain `vllm serve`.
